d: Khabargaon investigate the shocking reality behind SOS emergency buttons installed in cabs and buses across Delhi-NCR. These red SOS buttons, often seen near poles inside vehicles and marketed for passenger safety during travel emergencies, cost operators Charge around 18-20 thousand rupees yet frequently fail to alert police or provide any real help when pressed. A detailed ground report and investigation by Bhupinder Soni on KhabarGaon exposes how these safety features are largely non-functional showpieces sold mainly for profit, leaving both passengers and frustrated drivers without…
